people.imagined: Harvest morning at the great granary door. He has scooped a handful of rice from an open sack and is weighing it in his palm by eye, rain-cape of straw still on his shoulders over a silk robe, knowing the number before anyone tells him.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the open doors of a great granary at first light, a handful of pale rice lifted on his open palm, his eyes narrowed in exact judgement. Face: a big, square, deeply sun-darkened face, skin nearly the colour of dark tea; heavy straight black-and-grey brows; small shrewd brown eyes under lowered lids, calm and exact; a thick nose; a wide closed mouth with the corners drawn down; a short grey-flecked beard clipped square along the jaw. Hair: grey-black, thick, gathered in a high knot at the crown and held by a jade-green hairpin carved as a rice ear. Body: very broad in the shoulders and chest, heavy and solid, standing planted with his weight low. Clothing: a landlord-cultivator's layered robes of deep jade-green and celadon silk with three crossed collars and wide flowing sleeves, hems embroidered in silver-green with ripples and rice ears; over the shoulders a cloak of pale gold rice-straw fibre woven fine as silk gauze, the biggest shape in the frame, its fringe stirring in a spirit breeze; a wide brocade sash with a small round clay-coloured seal of jade and a tiny bronze bell on silk cords. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts the rice on a flat palm to eye level, a few grains drifting upward as if weightless; the left rests on the rim of a deep sack. Power: a steady Kết Đan aura of green-wood and pale blue water qi, soft motes of green light rising around his shoulders like a slow tide. Background: misty granary doors with stacked sacks and a row of blurred tenant figures in the pearly dawn. Light: ethereal pearl-blue dawn light and mist, a thin spirit-gold glow on the grains. Expression: eyes narrowed and mouth drawn down, a man who already knows the number and keeps it to himself, quietly acquisitive.

people.imagined: A muddy road on the way to a pill-broker. The cart has lost a wheel again. He sits on the cart's tilted bed in muddy trousers, looking at the wheel with the long patience of a man who has seen this before, not at all surprised.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on the tilted bed of a stranded cart on a misty road, looking at a fallen wheel with weary patience. Face: a long, tired, greying face that looks older than it should; dull brown skin with deep lines under the eyes and along the cheeks; thin grey brows; mild, patient brown eyes with heavy pouches; a long straight nose; a closed mouth with a faint resigned smile; a sparse thin grey beard. Hair: grey, thin, drawn back and tied at the nape with a jade-green ribbon, a few strands escaping across the temple. Body: tall, lean, stooped, long hands, narrow chest. Clothing: a heir's robes of soft green and grey-green silk gauze in two crossed collars with long loose sleeves, hems embroidered with faint wave and leaf borders in silver thread; the lower skirts muddied to the knee yet still graceful, a pale straw-fibre cape slipped off one shoulder, a plain jade pendant on a cord. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on his knee holding a small tightly tied silk bundle, the family's money for a pill; the left points loosely at the wheel. Power: a thin, tired haze of green-wood qi curls at his sleeves, Trúc Cơ level, soft and faint. Background: a flat misty paddy landscape under a pearl-grey sky, the cart's single ox looking back, the broken wheel half-sunk in a puddle that reflects pale light. Light: soft spirit-light diffused through mist, a faint cool rim light along his shoulder. Expression: patient, resigned, a trace of private calculation.

people.imagined: At a merchant's counter. She weighs a silver coin on her thumb, nods, and slides over twice the price. The pearls in her ears catch the lamp. Her husband's father does not know.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a shop counter, weighing a small silver coin on the pad of her thumb before pushing a heavy purse across to someone out of frame. Face: a handsome, narrow, fine-boned face; fair skin with a warm flush; large dark eyes, direct, honest and tense; thin, arched brows; a straight nose; a firm, slightly pressed mouth; no lines but one small crease between the brows. Hair: glossy black, in a smooth high coil pinned with two silver pins, a loose strand drifting. Body: slim, upright, quick. Clothing: layered robes of dove-grey and pale silver silk gauze with two crossed collars, wide sleeves, and a sash of deep jade-green; hems embroidered with fine silver-thread waves and leaves, modest but exquisite; in her ears a pair of large round white pearls, too fine for the house, the brightest points in the picture. Hands and objects: her right thumb and forefinger hold up a bright silver coin; the left pushes forward a round purse bulging with coin; at her hip a slender straight sword in a pale scabbard with a silver chape. Power: a cold shimmer of silver metal qi runs along the scabbard, with a few motes of pale green light at her fingertips, Trúc Cơ level. Background: a dim shop of shelves and jars glowing softly, a hanging lantern, a blurred shopkeeper's hand. Light: warm lantern glow with a moonlit silver rim along her cheek, glints on the pearls and the coin. Expression: tense, loyal, determined, a little guilty.

people.imagined: Beside the Tower's tall counters at harvest. He has dozed off over the count with his chin on his chest, a tally stick behind one ear, and opens one eye in a reverent squint when a counter strides past.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stool at a harvest counting table, half-dozing, one eye cracked open in a reverent squint at a tall official passing in the blur. Face: a soft, round, easy face; pale brown skin; heavy drooping lids; a short wide nose; a small slack mouth with a trace of drool; plump cheeks; thin sparse brows; a day's grey stubble. Hair: dark, thinning, tied in a small loose knot with a green cord; a short bamboo tally stick tucked behind the right ear, notched along one edge. Body: soft, wide-hipped, round-shouldered, slouched. Clothing: loose layered robes of mid-green silk and pale gauze, three collars crossed carelessly, a loosened sash, wide sleeves slipping; hems embroidered with small leaf scrolls in pale gold thread; a short pale straw-silk cape across the shoulders; a jade bead on a cord. Hands and objects: the right hand lies loose on a long table beside a pile of notched jade-green sticks; the left holds a bamboo stick upright as if forgetting it; fingers thick and soft. Power: a few drowsy motes of green-wood light drift lazily above the sticks, as if dozing too. Background: a courtyard of stacked sacks and tall counting frames hung with notched sticks, a bright striped awning, sparrows on a sack, a blurred young man signing sticks in the corner, all in soft mist. Light: soft gold spirit-light through the awning, gentle haze. Expression: a sleepy, slack, trusting look, the heavy lids drooping, one eye cracked open with reverent awe at the passing official.

people.imagined: Dusk on the far bank, where the fields stayed dry. He stands at the edge of a cracked paddy with a hoe, grey dust in his eyebrows, looking across a river where the rice is green.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dry, cracked paddy at dusk, leaning on a hoe, looking across a river at green fields on the far bank. Face: a lean, brown, kind face, lined; grey dust lying in his thick eyebrows like frost; steady dark eyes; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth; rough grey stubble. Hair: grey-brown, cut short, under a wide pale straw hat pushed back, its ribbon of sea-green silk. Body: lean and tough, narrow-hipped, with a worker's slight stoop; he grips the hoe with both fists low on the handle, its blade resting in a crack wide enough to take a finger. Clothing: the plainest graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a simple robe of earth-brown and faded sage-green gauze with one crossed collar and sleeves rolled to the elbow, a neatly mended collar, hems with a thin border of embroidered leaves in dull silver thread; a coil of rope over one shoulder, a water gourd on a cord; bare feet grey with dust, his shoes left on the bank. Hands and objects: both hands wrap the hoe handle, brown skin cracked across every knuckle. Power: none but a faint dusty-green glimmer in the air that gathers on the far bank and not on his. Background: cracked pale earth in a web pattern, a dried-up channel and a few dead stalks; across a wide silver river, green rice, a lit window and a plume of cook-smoke in violet mist. Light: low amber-and-rose dusk glow with soft rim light along his shoulder. Expression: a quiet, steady, unyielding gaze across the water, the mouth shut firm and the eyes soft with something like pity.

people.imagined: Beside a row of small mounds. She does not look away from the visitor. Her grey streaks are loose in the wind. She wants to know why only one bank had rain.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a row of small earthen mounds in a paddy, staring straight at the viewer without blinking. Face: a lean, strong, brown face with high cheekbones; deep dark eyes with a hard, steady, unblinking stare; straight black brows; a firm straight nose; a thin mouth held still; fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black with wide streaks of grey from both temples, left unhidden, tied back low with a plain pale ribbon, loose strands lifting in the wind. Body: slim, upright, strong forearms. Clothing: simple graceful layered silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a robe of dark blue-green gauze with a high stiff crossed collar embroidered with a narrow band of waves in paler thread, a gift of the house that does not quite suit her; an undergown of plain pale brown silk to the ankle; a white mourning band on the upper left arm; bare feet on the earth. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front, right over left, brown and cracked; at her feet a small bundle of herbs and a chipped clay cup between two small low mounds topped with dried grass. Power: a faint cool green glimmer rising from the mounds, and a few motes of blue water-light that circle her and never settle. Background: a green paddy that ends at a river whose far bank is dry and pale; a single crow on a stake; a thin colourless sky in drifting mist. Light: pale moonlike spirit-light from the upper left, mist at her feet. Expression: an unblinking, steady stare with the thin mouth held still, a long cold patience that has stopped hoping and not stopped waiting.

people.imagined: On a stone road at the Tower's gate, carrying a bundle of letters for his cousin. His landlord's boots pinch his feet; his tenant's heels hurt in them; he is smiling at everyone anyway.
people.subject: The moment: walking up a stone road carrying a bundle of letters, smiling broadly, his feet in shoes that are visibly too small. Face: a young, open, round-cheeked face; sun-browned; warm eager brown eyes; thick brows; a wide nose; a broad friendly smile with a gap in his teeth; light stubble. Hair: black, short and untidy, tied half-up with a green ribbon, a bit of straw in it. Body: stocky, strong and easy, slightly bowed, with a rolling step as if his feet hurt, the toes of the shoes curling up. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a jacket-robe of dark green gauze with a crossed collar and wide sleeves rolled once to show a pale green silk lining, hems embroidered with small leaf borders in silver; a sash of undyed cloud-white silk; fine black silk slippers a size too small, toes turned up; a short strap of the letter satchel across his chest. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a bundle of folded letters tied with a red silk cord; the left lifts in greeting. Power: none, only a soft sparkle of green motes that follows his lifted hand. Background: a stone-paved road climbs to a tall grey gate with a dark-tiled roof at the top of a flight of steps, two guards tiny in the distance, pink blossom heavy along the hedge, a tenant's cart drawn as a soft shape, all in morning mist. Light: radiant pearly morning light with a gentle golden rim. Expression: a wide, open, trusting grin, the eyes bright and eager to be liked, with no hint that his feet hurt.

people.imagined: In a mirror's reflection she will not meet. She looks past it, tight-lipped, with a letter folded in her sleeve offering something she should not offer.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a plain room with her mouth drawn tight, her face turned away from a bronze mirror beside her, a letter's edge showing in her sleeve. Face: a pale, narrow, angular young face; eyes of a cold grey, her mother's; thin, hard, level brows; a thin straight nose; lips pressed into a tight line; a faint spot of angry colour on each cheekbone. Hair: black, pulled back tight into a single hard knot with a slim silver pin. Body: slim, rigid and upright, shoulders square, chin held a little too high. Clothing: graceful simple silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a robe of dark jade-green gauze over a pale undergown, high crossed collar, narrow-but-flowing sleeves, hems embroidered in thin silver-grey thread with a plain wave border; a pale sash and a short slender sword at her belt in a grey scabbard; the folded edge of a letter at the left cuff. Hands and objects: the right hand grips the hilt, knuckles pale; the left sleeve hides the letter, its fingers just short of the mirror lying tilted on a low table. Power: a sharp, thin shimmer of silver-grey metal qi flickers around the sword hilt, small and stubborn, where two points were missing. Background: a bare room with a whitewashed wall, a closed chest, a hard-backed chair, a bar of cold window light across the boards, softly hazed. Light: cold pale moonlight from the upper left with a silver rim light along her jaw. Expression: stiff and resentful, the lips pressed to a thin line, her head turned from the mirror as if it had insulted her.

people.imagined: In the granary by lamplight, counting sacks under his breath instead of humming, flour on his fingers, squinting at a stack. He knows exactly what the Tower never sees.
people.subject: The moment: in a granary at night, pointing at stacked sacks one by one with a rice-floured finger, lips moving as he counts. Face: a mild, round, honest face; soft brown eyes squinting against lamplight; thin even brows; a short nose; a calm mouth moving through numbers; a trace of white flour on the cheek. Hair: black, short, tied in a small knot, flour settled in fine white in his hair and eyebrows. Body: medium, soft-shouldered, neat, leaning close to the stack, one foot on a low stool. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a clean robe of mid-green gauze with a crossed collar, wide sleeves tied back with silk cord, hems embroidered with thin gold-green grain-ear borders, flour dusting the cloth; a small bone counter, one for each hundred sacks, hangs from his sash on a jade-green cord. Hands and objects: all the fingers of the right hand are white with rice flour, large in the picture; the left holds a small lamp of pale glowing jade. Power: a soft mote-glow of warm grain-gold and green qi hangs around the lamp and drifts between the sacks like fireflies. Background: sacks climb to the rafters in tidy rows, each tied with a different coloured silk string, rice dust glittering in the lamplight, a heavy iron-banded door ajar to the night, a tally board of drawn dots on a nail, a grey rat's tail poking from behind a sack. Light: warm spirit-lamp glow from the lower left, soft silver moonlight at the door, drifting haze. Expression: a careful, kind look, the lips moving over the count and the soft eyes squinting, quietly weighing every sack.

people.imagined: Remembered: the captain on the new white-sand jetty he built, a bride's family behind him, his hand on a mooring post, proud, sea behind.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a sea captain at forty, standing proud on a new pale jetty with one hand on a mooring post, wind in his robes. Face: a bold, weathered, handsome face; deep tan; bright blue-grey eyes narrowed against sun; thick dark brows; a straight nose; a broad confident smile; a short black beard with a few grey hairs. Hair: black, tied back in a sailor's tail with a sea-blue silk band, whipping to the left. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, upright. Clothing: the robes of a sea-going cultivator captain: layered sea-blue and white silk with two crossed collars, a long outer robe of deep indigo gauze with wide sleeves flying, hems embroidered in silver with waves and cresting foam; a vermilion sash; a large gold ring on the right hand; polished gold clasps at the collar, the collar turned up against the wind. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a mooring post of pale new timber; the left points to sea. Beside him a small chest with a glowing ship's lantern; behind him, small and respectful, a young woman in pale sea-green gown and headscarf watches him. Power: a bright swell of blue water qi around him, motes of sea-light rising from his sleeves. Background: a long white-sand beach, the jetty, three tall cream-sailed ships riding far out, gulls wheeling, a pale sky and drifting spray. Light: luminous sea light and soft mist. Expression: a bold, joyous grin lifted toward the sea. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, as a memorial.

people.imagined: At a bargaining table on the quay, a rod case at his belt, eyes on the sky over the buyer's head, mid-sentence, reading weather in the haze while pricing a cargo.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a bargaining table on a quay, head tilted up to watch the sky while a hand rests on a small counting-rod case. Face: a small, quick, lined face; weathered brown skin; bright brown eyes tilted to the sky, a little amused; thin dark brows; a short nose; a thin mouth about to quote a price; a trim grey-black beard. Hair: black with grey, in a topknot under a slim sea-blue silk cap pinned with a pearl-white jade. Body: small, wiry and quick, neatly seated, head tipped back. Clothing: the rich robes of a Kết Đan house head: layered pale sand, cream and deep sea-blue silk, three crossed collars, wide sleeves of fine gauze, an over-robe in sea-blue brocade embroidered in silver with tide-lines, ships and clouds; a heavy sash with a bamboo counting-rod case hung from it on jade cords; on his right hand a heavy plain ring of pale jade. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the rod case; the left holds flat a small round bronze mirror turned to the sky, fingers dry and nimble. Power: a calm, strong aura of sea-blue water qi and soft green wood motes streams about him, ripples of light spreading across the table. Background: a quay of stacked crates, coiled rope and tall masts, porters passing in conical hats, a small brass scale, one line of haze on the horizon, all in luminous mist. Light: bright pearl-white sea light with a soft silver rim. Expression: a friendly, amused half-smile, a trader already sure of his price.

people.imagined: On the deck of the flagship at the rail, shouting an order up the mast in a voice made for it, white beard whipping, jaw set against the second holds he hates.
people.subject: The moment: at a ship's rail in wind, one hand cupped to his mouth, bellowing an order up the mast. Face: a weathered, hard, strong face; deep tan; narrow grey eyes; thick white brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth; a full, bright salt-white beard blown sideways and wet with spray. Hair: white and cropped, under a faded blue silk cap with a jade clasp. Body: tall, broad, long-armed, a captain's stance, feet spread wide on the deck, a rope wound round his left wrist. Clothing: the rich robes of a Trúc Cơ admiral: layered white and deep sea-blue silk with two crossed collars, a long outer coat of dark indigo gauze brocade with a high collar and wide sleeves tied back with silver cord, flaring in the wind; hems embroidered in silver with waves and a ship; a belt with a short sword in a pale sea-green scabbard, plain steel guard; salt on the shoulders. Hands and objects: the left hand cupped at his mouth; the right grips a rope. Power: a heavy surge of blue water qi curls about him like a following wave, spray glittering as spirit-motes. Background: the main mast with a huge taut cream sail, men in dark jackets hauling lines, a following ship low on the grey swell, a pale seabird, the horizon tilting with the roll; a barrel lashed to the rail. Light: strong cold moon-pale sea light, silver rim along his beard and shoulders, mist at the rail. Expression: a stern, furious, bellowing look, the narrow grey eyes fierce under white brows.

people.imagined: In the warehouse aisle. She keeps a shawl on indoors, hands tucked in it, counting crates without opening them, careful not to ask.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dim warehouse aisle in a shawl, one hand on a crate, careful not to look inside. Face: a quiet, pale, narrow face half in shadow; careful dark eyes cast down; thin straight brows; a small nose; a closed mouth. Hair: black with a few strands of grey at the temples, in a plain tidy knot with a dark jade pin. Body: slight and upright, perfectly still, the shawl held shut across her chest. Clothing: layered robes of fine dove-grey and brown-grey silk with two crossed collars and narrow flowing cuffs, hems embroidered with faint silver waves; over the shoulders a soft shawl of thick undyed wool-silk with a darker border, held closed at the throat with a pale wooden pin; at her sash a small ring of keys and a pouch of pine-soot crayons. Hands and objects: the right palm, raised from the shawl, has pine-soot black in every groove of the skin, plain and big. Power: a faint metal-silver and green gleam at the keys, a very quiet Trúc Cơ aura held in. Background: the warehouse stretches away in towering stacks of pale crates tied with rope, each marked with a painted dot of a different colour, hanging lanterns of soft light at intervals, an open door to a dark quay, a draught lifting her shawl's fringe, silver mist on the floor. Light: dim pearl lantern glow from the upper left, thin moonlight from the door, silver rim along her cheek. Expression: a careful, lowered, closed look, the eyes fixed on the crate's edge and never on what is inside it.

people.imagined: At dawn on a balcony with a brush, composing a poem, eyes drifting to the ceiling halfway through a sentence, ink on his cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low table at dawn on a balcony, brush lifted, eyes drifting up to the ceiling mid-sentence. Face: a soft, fine, dreamy face; fair skin; far-off grey eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a gentle half-smile; a thin moustache. Hair: black with grey, loose to the shoulder, a pale blue silk band. Body: tall, slim, relaxed, sitting cross-legged with his back to a pillar and one knee raised for his arm. Clothing: a poet's flowing robes in layers of blue-grey, pale lilac and white gauze, three crossed collars hanging open at the throat, very wide sleeves; hems embroidered in silver with waves and cranes; both cuffs stained with black ink, plain and big, a long streak down each; a loose sash with a small carved jade fish hanging from it. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush; the left a blank sheet; a bowl of cold tea and a half-eaten rice cake sit forgotten, scattered blank sheets weighted with stones, a brush rack shaped as a bamboo boat. Power: a faint drift of blue water qi and pale light motes gathers where the brush hovers, as if the poem were half-formed in the air. Background: a balcony over a slate-blue harbour with masts like a thicket, a pearl-pink dawn along the horizon, gulls on the rail, a basket of sea-pinks, rolling mist. Light: pale pink-and-silver dawn light, a soft glow of spirit-light. Expression: a dreamy, easy half-smile, the eyes drifting up, quite unaware of the ink on his hand.

people.imagined: On the quay, hands cupped, calling across the harbour for a ship, her pilot's squint narrowing as she judges the wind.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a quay, calling across the harbour at the top of her voice, squinting. Face: a strong, brown, weathered face; narrowed grey-brown eyes in a permanent pilot's squint with deep crow's-feet; thick straight brows; a short nose; a wide mouth open mid-shout. Hair: black-grey, tied under a sea-blue silk head-scarf. Body: sturdy, broad-shouldered, stands braced. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a short outer robe of dark sea-blue gauze with a standing collar and a double row of pale horn buttons, over a long pale undergown tied at the knee, sleeves rolled to the elbow; hems embroidered with thin silver waves; a white silk scarf at the neck flapping; grey sealskin boots; a brass whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: both hands cupped at her mouth; forearms brown and strong with a pale scar across the left. Power: a few bright motes of blue water qi stream from her mouth with the call, as if the voice carried wind with it. Background: the harbour mouth, a wide basin with a mole of pale stone, a red-sailed lugger coming in on a following wind, small boats waiting, spray on the stone, two gulls hanging motionless, long streaks of cloud, fine mist. Light: bright wind-swept pearl-white light with a cool silver rim. Expression: a fierce, impatient squint with the wide mouth thrown open, a pilot never afraid of the water and out of patience with the boat.

people.imagined: Across a desk, reading a ledger upside down, an ink smudge under her left eye, frowning at figures that stop matching.
people.subject: The moment: leaning across a desk, reading a ledger upside down, a small frown. Face: a thin, clever, young face; sharp dark eyes; level thin brows pulled in; a small nose; a closed mouth; a small black ink fingerprint smudged under the left eye. Hair: black, in a long braid pinned up with a pale jade stick. Body: slim, leaning forward. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a robe of soft grey-blue gauze with a crossed collar and long sleeves pushed to the elbow in neat folds, over a pale cream undergown; hems embroidered in silver thread with tiny waves; a narrow sash with a tiny brass abacus charm. Hands and objects: her hands are long and neat; the right forefinger runs down a column of small drawn marks while the left holds a second ledger open at a different page; a cup of cold tea at her elbow. Power: faint blue water-light motes tick down the columns with her finger, like counters. Background: an office with a high window onto masts, a wall of numbered pigeonholes full of rolled charts, a lamp of soft glowing glass, a second desk piled with sealed packets, a tiny model ship on the sill, pale sea mist at the window. Light: soft silver-white window light with a gentle glow from the lamp. Expression: a small, sharp frown, the lips pursed, hunting a sum that refuses to add.

people.imagined: At the oars of a big boat, laughing a laugh that clacks like a rowlock, a song half sung.
people.subject: The moment: at the oars of a boat, laughing with his chest thrown out. Face: a broad, tanned, merry face; bright eyes; thick brows; a wide nose; a huge laughing mouth with large square teeth. Hair: black and curly, tied with a sea-blue silk cloth knotted at the brow, salt drying in it. Body: a huge barrel chest thrust out so the robe strains, forearms thick as logs, head thrown back so the throat shows. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a short sea-blue outer robe of fine gauze trimmed in white braid, open at the chest, wide sleeves tied back, over a pale undergown; hems embroidered with silver waves; a yellow silk sash; a rowlock-shaped bronze charm on a chain. Hands and objects: both hands on an oar, the wooden grip lost in his fist. Power: bright blue water qi spills from the oar blade in glittering motes, a spray of spirit-light with every stroke. Background: a white-sand beach curving behind him in a long pale arc, women with baskets on the shore, a low whitewashed town, wheeling gulls, a line of oars rising and falling in the blur, a cloudless pale sky, soft haze over the water. Light: bright luminous sun with sparkling highlights on the wet oar blade and a pearly rim light. Expression: a huge, merry, open-mouthed laugh with the eyes screwed shut, a man happy with the water and his own strength.

people.imagined: Standing straight outside a school gate, as if someone might stop looking, a long nose and a chin scar, wanting the place her brother keeps leaving.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight outside a school gate, chin lifted. Face: a plain, long-nosed, earnest young face; a small pale scar across the chin, a thin white crescent; steady grey eyes; thin brows; a firm mouth. Hair: black, in a tidy braid tied with a pale blue ribbon. Body: slim, straight, like a post, shoulders squared, heels together, trying to look as sturdy as she can. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a robe of pale grey gauze with a flat crossed collar and neatly folded flowing sleeves, over a white undergown; hems embroidered with thin silver wave lines; a pale sea-blue sash; spotless and precise. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front, holding a small jade pendant shaped like a fish, hanging from her clasped fingers. Power: a few timid motes of blue light gather around the pendant, small and hopeful. Background: a tall gate of grey stone with a tiled roof and wooden doors half open on a courtyard of pale gravel, a plum tree in bloom, two older students in grey robes passing in the blur, a worn stone step, a path of pebbles leading to her feet, a cool pale sky with drifting mist. Light: soft pearl light with a faint silver rim along her cheek and the scar. Expression: an earnest, humble look with the chin lifted, the eyes steady and a little over-bright, the mouth firm with effort.

people.imagined: Remembered: the silk trader among piled cocoons, hands full, bargaining with a picker and laughing.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a silk trader at fifty, seated heavy and comfortable, weighing a basket of white cocoons in both hands with a broad laugh. Face: a warm, round, tanned face; bright eyes crinkled; thick brows; a short nose; a huge generous smile; a short grey beard. Hair: grey, tied up with a yellow silk cord and a small amber pin. Body: stout and jolly, belly resting on the knees, one sleeve rolled to show a thick forearm. Clothing: the rich robes of a silk-trading cultivator: layered cream and gold silk with two crossed collars, a glossy over-robe of cream brocade woven with small silkworm and mulberry-leaf patterns, wide flowing sleeves, hems embroidered in gold with cocoons and clouds; a wide gold-yellow sash. Hands and objects: both hands hold a basket of white cocoons round as eggs, a few spilling over his fingers; a small silver scale hangs at his side. Power: a warm ember-gold glow clings to the cocoons and his hands, soft golden motes rising like fireflies. Background: bamboo trays heaped with white and yellow cocoons, mulberry trees in leaf, pickers in broad hats arriving with baskets, a striped awning, a boy with a shoulder pole, warm haze. Light: warm gold spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a huge, generous, crinkle-eyed smile, a man delighted with the weight in his hands. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, as a memorial.

people.imagined: At her reeling basin in the shed, a gold needle in her hair, burn scars on her small hands, shouting across the whole market through a window, a fine red thread running through her fingers.
people.subject: The moment: at a reeling basin, drawing a fine red thread through her fingers while calling out loudly through a window. Face: a small, sharp, handsome face; brown skin with pale burn scars at the jaw and temple; bright fierce dark eyes; strong straight brows; a small nose; a wide mouth open mid-call. Hair: black, in a high coil pinned with a golden needle as long as a finger. Body: small, wiry, quick, a little on tiptoe, leaning toward the window with one hand gripping the basin rim; steam wets her face and loose hair. Clothing: the rich robes of a Trúc Cơ house head: layered deep crimson and ember-red silk with three crossed collars, wide sleeves tied back with yellow cords, an over-robe of crimson brocade embroidered in gold thread with cocoons, flames and clouds; a dark mulberry-wood thimble on her right middle finger; gold ornaments in her hair. Hands and objects: both hands marked with fine pale burn scars, plain; they draw a red silk thread from a steaming basin. Power: a bright aura of fire-red and earth-gold qi flares around her, red sparks of spirit-light following the thread like embers. Background: a shed of round copper basins each with a plume of glowing steam, silk reels turning, red and white threads strung across the rafters like a web, a girl at the next basin in blur, the bright silk market in the window. Light: warm orange steam-lit glow with a golden rim light. Expression: a fierce, proud, wrathful look, the mouth open in a shout, eyes blazing, her hands still gentle on the thread.

people.imagined: At the market table in good brocade, a smooth soft smile, a cup of tea, never raising his voice and never lowering his price first.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a market table with a tea cup, smiling smoothly. Face: a soft, round, clean-shaven face; pale skin; calm, bland, clever eyes; thin smooth brows; a short nose; a small pleasant smile. Hair: black, oiled, held by a gold pin shaped like a moth, under a small gold-edged crown. Body: round, soft, composed. Clothing: the rich robes of a Trúc Cơ house steward: layers of cream and wine-red silk with three crossed collars, a heavy dark-red brocade over-robe woven with tiny cocoons in gold thread, a high collar and wide sleeves lined in cream; a plain jade ring on each thumb; a gold-threaded sash with a small glowing jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands wrap a small tea cup, the little finger lifted; hands plump, soft and clean with neat nails; the table is spread with three small bolts of silk in different reds, a tea tray, brass scales and a thin black abacus. Power: a warm ember-red and earth-gold shimmer rises with the tea steam, pooling smoothly around his hands. Background: an awning striped red and cream, the blurred market crowd and the shape of an official in a green coat leaning over the table, all in soft golden mist. Light: warm gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim along his cheek. Expression: a smooth, pleasant, closed smile with calm, bland eyes, friendly on the surface and totting up the table beneath it.

people.imagined: At the counting table, a bundle in her hand and a mood on her face, deciding by the day whether to credit or dock it.
people.subject: The moment: holding up a bundle of mulberry leaves at a counting table, deciding with a scowl. Face: a lean, kind-looking, brown face; sharp eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a pressed mouth. Hair: grey-black, in a plain bun with a green silk ribbon and a wooden pin. Body: thin, wiry, strong with a straight back, the right shoulder a little lower from carrying baskets. Clothing: the graceful robes of a Trúc Cơ cultivator in a silk house: layered green and cream silk with two crossed collars, a robe of leaf-green gauze, sleeves rolled up over brown wiry forearms, a grass-green stain along the hem that no washing removes, hems embroidered in dull gold with mulberry leaves; a tally of notched sticks tied at her sash with a jade bead. Hands and objects: the knuckles of both hands swollen like walnuts, plain; the right holds the leaf bundle and a tally. Power: a soft aura of earth-gold and green wood qi, small green motes lifting off the leaves and settling on her sleeve. Background: low green rows of mulberry bushes stretching to the horizon, pickers in broad straw hats bending over them, baskets of bright leaves at the row ends, a thin woman in a grey headcloth with an empty basket off to the side, drawn blurred, a hazy golden sky. Light: bright luminous light from the upper left with a pale green rim. Expression: a scowl of judgement, the brows low and the lips pushed forward, deciding with arbitrary weight whether the leaves are good enough.

people.imagined: At a reeling basin, her fingers never still even when she looks up, as if reeling thread from the air.
people.subject: The moment: looking up from a basin while her fingers keep moving. Face: a quiet, thin, pale face; steady dark eyes; level brows; a small nose; a closed mouth; fine lines at the corners of the eyes. Hair: black, tied back neatly with a red silk cord. Body: slim and still, sitting straight at the basin with sleeves tied back, wrists held loose and high, fingers curled as if round a thread that is not there, the movement showing as faint repeated outlines. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a robe of red-brown gauze with a crossed collar, wide sleeves tied back, over a pale cream undergown; hems embroidered in amber thread with cocoons; a cord at the waist with a wooden thimble. Hands and objects: the fingers of both hands pinch the air as if drawing a thread, long, pale and dry, nails cut short. Power: a delicate thread of ember-red light hangs in the air between her fingers, almost invisible, the very thread she seems to draw. Background: the reeling shed, a long row of copper basins with glowing steam, red and white skeins hanging from poles, a narrow window of white light, a younger girl in blur with cocoons, a door ajar to a cellar stair going down into darkness. Light: warm amber spirit-light from the upper left, steam glowing white in the window. Expression: a calm, almost sleepy look, the face of a woman who keeps her thoughts the way she keeps her silk, wound tight and out of sight.

people.imagined: Practising a soldier's pose before a bronze mirror, a thin new moustache, blisters on both palms.
people.subject: The moment: standing proudly with a spear in a yard, a thin new moustache twirled between finger and thumb. Face: a young, eager, sun-flushed face; bright dark eyes; thick black brows; a thin wispy moustache barely there above a wide grin. Hair: black, tied high with a red silk cord. Body: lean and strong, chest out and chin raised in imitation of a soldier, spear grounded at his side. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a red-brown robe of gauze cut like a soldier's, with a high crossed collar and sleeves held by silk bracers on both forearms; a wide sash with a brass buckle; hems embroidered in amber thread with small flames. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a spear with a ruddy silk tassel; the first finger and thumb of the left stroke the moustache; each palm shows a red shiny blister. Power: small ember-red sparks flicker at the spear tip, eager and a little show-off. Background: a packed-earth yard with a wooden practice post, a rack of spears, a straw target, a low wall with silk-drying frames behind it, a flag snapping in the wind, an older woman in the doorway watching with folded arms, a blur, in soft haze. Light: bright golden afternoon light with a warm rim. Expression: a proud, eager, slightly show-off grin with the chin lifted, a boy playing at being the soldier he hopes to become.

people.imagined: At the weavers' door, a bundle of samples in her arms, bracelets of silk thread on both wrists, a guilty glance.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a weavers' door with a bundle of cloth samples, a quick sideways glance. Face: a bright, pretty, round face; quick dark eyes with a teasing glint; high arched brows; a small nose; a half-smile on soft lips; cheeks flushed. Hair: black, in a loose braid with a coloured thread twisted through it and a few strands loose at the temples. Body: slim and quick, holding the bundle against her chest, one shoulder turned away and her head half-turned over it. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a light robe of red-brown gauze with long loose sleeves showing her forearms, over a cream undergown, a bright blue sash; hems embroidered in amber thread with tiny cocoons. Hands and objects: on each wrist five or six silk-thread bracelets in blue, green, saffron, rose, black and white; both hands clutch the bundle of cloth samples. Power: a soft ember-pink shimmer follows the coloured thread bracelets, faint motes dancing at her wrists. Background: a tall arched weavers' doorway with a bright interior, a great loom with half-woven cloth in coloured stripes, women at benches in blur, a boy sweeping the step with his head down, golden haze. Light: warm spirit-light from the upper left with a rose rim light. Expression: a quick, charming half-smile with a sly sideways glance, the face of a girl who has already sold you something.

people.imagined: Ducking his head at a doorway he does not need to duck under, a frown carved between his brows, not going out to watch the levy ride past.
people.subject: The moment: ducking his head under a doorway lintel that he clears easily, a frown set. Face: a heavy, closed, brown face; a deep vertical frown line carved between the brows, the plainest thing on it; dark eyes lowered; a broad nose; a hard, downturned mouth. Hair: black, cropped close, a little grey at the temples. Body: tall and heavy, hunched, shoulders bunched and neck stretched forward under the lintel. Clothing: simple robes of a Luyện Khí cultivator in a silk house, a little plainer than the house's finest: a brown robe of heavy gauze silk with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled above hairy forearms, a dark scorched work-apron of sturdy silk over it with burn marks, hems embroidered in dull amber with cocoons; thick-soled, dusty boots. Hands and objects: the right hand on the doorframe, a scar across its back. Power: a heavy ember glow gathers at his shoulders like banked coals, dull orange and earth-gold. Background: the doorway of a reeling shed with glowing steam and heat at his back, rows of copper basins and girls bent over them in blur; outside in the road a line of mounted riders in red passes, small and indistinct, with a banner bearing no marks; he is turned away from them. Light: dim heavy amber light from the upper left, a gleam of steam behind, a faint red rim. Expression: a deep vertical frown cut between the brows, the eyes lowered and the hard mouth shut, a man refusing something without a word.

people.imagined: Beside racks of red cocoons warmed by a vent stone, her hands warm even in winter, grinning, sneaking a visit.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside racks of red cocoons, hands held out warm, sneaking a visit. Face: a round, rosy, bright face; bold dark eyes; thick brows; a wide grin showing a gap between the front teeth; freckles across the nose. Hair: brown, in one thick braid tied with a red ribbon. Body: sturdy, feet planted and chest out, the face lifted proudly, a tray balanced at waist height; the broad hands are plain. Clothing: simple graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a red-brown overdress of gauze with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled up, over a cream undergown, a belt of knotted red silk cord and a wide pocket stuffed with silk thread; hems embroidered in amber with small cocoons. Hands and objects: both hands hold a tray of fat red cocoons like small red lanterns, her forearms rosy. Power: a warm ember glow in her palms, soft red-gold motes drifting up from the cocoons. Background: racks of wooden trays rising behind her, each packed with red cocoons, a flat grey stone glowing orange-red in a niche to warm them, a basket of mulberry leaves, a thin warm haze above everything. Light: orange glow from the niche on her right cheek, soft golden key light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, bold, cheerful grin with bright, unabashed eyes, proud of the tray and of herself.

people.imagined: Winded from a flight of steps, holding up his first unbroken thread in both careful hands, pale and proud.
people.subject: The moment: holding up a single unbroken thread in both hands, pale and breathless after a climb. Face: a thin, pale, serious young face; wide earnest eyes; thin brows pulled together; a small nose; a small proud mouth pressed tight; two spots of pink on the cheeks. Hair: black and soft, damp at the forehead. Body: thin and narrow, shoulders heaving slightly, one hand pressed to his ribs, his frame lost in a robe too big at the shoulders, sleeves bunched at the wrists. Clothing: the plainest graceful silk of a Luyện Khí cultivator: a red-brown robe of soft gauze with a high crossed collar, cords tied at the wrists, a pale undergown, hems with a thin amber border of tiny cocoons. Hands and objects: a fine white thread held taut between two small wooden pegs; fingers clean, long, and trembling a little. Power: the thread glows faintly with ember-gold light, a single bright line, as if it held his first qi. Background: a steep flight of narrow stone steps climbing to a shed door with glowing steam leaking out, copper basins visible within, a woman's hand, his mother's, reaching toward his shoulder from the edge of the frame, a bright morning sky over the roof, soft mist. Light: warm pearly morning light with a golden rim along his hair. Expression: a breathless, proud, careful look with wide earnest eyes, afraid to breathe on the thread.
